a: matchSpacing filters reference gaps against the pre-snap box, so a snap that carries the box into a gap's strip still marks that gap
Add and replace guide ops that change nothing still record an undo step
Equal-spacing EPS of 1e-6 is absolute, so far from the origin rounding in `x + width` reads touching boxes as overlapping or gapped
b: createAddGuideOp and createReplaceGuideOp record an undo step for a write that changed nothing
siblingBounds/worldBoundsOf ignore parallax planes, which deriveAlignmentGuides carries out to the camera's world
